description: Align desktop core updater bundle id with com.openagents.desktop across update.coax, smoke.coax, and proto/coder/desktop-update-v1.json.

steps.send: Align the desktop core updater with `com.openagents.desktop` (#13784): update `coax/lib/agent/desktop/update.coax`, `coax/lib/agent/desktop/smoke.coax`, `proto/coder/desktop-update-v1.json`, and `evals/coder-desktop/host_driver/build.sh` to reference `com.openagents.desktop` consistently.
